# Tasks & Design Notes: Oralcare (Toothcare recreation)

## Overview

- **Source Template**: ColorLib Toothcare (`https://colorlib.com/wp/template/toothcare/`)
- **New Name**: `oralcare` (`apps/oralcare`)
- **Design Category**: Dental Clinic & Healthcare

## Section Structure & Order (1:1 with Toothcare)

1. **Top Bar**: Contact hours, phone number, location, and social links.
2. **Navbar**: Brand logo ("Oralcare"), nav links (Home, Dentist, About, Services, Pricing, Blog, Contact), and "Make An Appointment" CTA button.
3. **Hero Slider Banner**: Headline ("Dentist Services that You Can Trust"), subheading, and action buttons ("See Our Services", "Make An Appointment").
4. **Appointment Booking Section**: Side-by-side layout with info on the left and interactive appointment booking form on the right (Name, Email, Phone, Date, Time, Doctor selection, Message).
5. **Stats / Counter Banner**: Key metrics (3000+ Happy Patients, 2200+ Performed Treatments, 24 Years of Experience).
6. **Services Grid**: 8 dental care services (Tooth Protection, Dental Implants, Dental Care, Teeth Whitening, Tooth Calculus, Tooth Removal, Removal of Tartar, Tooth Inspection) with icons and descriptions.
7. **About Clinic Section**: "Welcome to our Dental Clinic" intro, innovative approach details.
8. **Our Doctors Section**: Qualified dentist cards with photos (Picsum seed), roles (Head Dentist, Dentist), and bios.
9. **Testimonial Section**: Happy customer reviews carousel/grid.
10. **Stories / Treatment Results**: Success stories with location and patient names.
11. **Blog Section**: Latest dental health tips and articles.
12. **Footer**: Quick links, contact info, and mandatory Component Dock attribution (`https://www.componentdock.com/`).

## Design Tokens & Fidelity Notes

- **Primary Color**: Cyan / Teal `#00bcd4` via Tailwind theme (`--color-primary: #00bcd4`).
- **Font**: Roboto / sans-serif.
- **Images**: Unsplash/Picsum deterministic seeds (`https://picsum.photos/seed/oralcare-doctor-1/400/400`).
- **Forbidden**: No mention of ColorLib anywhere in app source code. Footer includes Component Dock link.
